 Deputies identify suspect accused of robbing Greenville bank in broad daylight 
 The Greenville County Sheriff’s Office said a man has been charged following a bank robbery on Monday morning. By Lorenza Medley Published : Nov. 16, 2026 at 11:04 AM EST | Updated : 58 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google GREENVILLE, S.C. (FOX Carolina) - The Greenville County Sheriff’s Office said a man has been charged following a bank robbery on Monday morning.
 Around 11:40 a.m., deputies said a robbery suspect at the Truist Bank at 2111 Wade Hampton Boulevard had been taken into custody.
 If you see him, call 911. (Greenville County Sheriff's Office) Deputies said the 911 call came in just after 10:30 a.m. after a male entered the bank. He implied that he had a weapon and robbed the bank of an undisclosed amount of cash.
 The man then reportedly left and entered the nearby McDonald’s where deputies said he changed clothes.
 Deputies said they used K-9s to search for the suspect before he was eventually taken into custody while preparing to get on a bus.
 Ricky Andreal Counts (Greenville County Detention Center) The suspect was identified as 67-year-old Ricky Andreal Counts. Officials said he has been charged with the following:
 Bank robbery 
 Armed robbery 
 Grand larceny 
 The sheriff’s office mentioned that they were able to recover the money stolen from the bank. 
 Stay with FOX Carolina as we work to learn more.
